Multiple sources confirm that crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru on several occasions. A crocodile was spotted in the lake on December 1, 2024, near the fishermen's shed, and a photograph was captured by K.U. Varghese. [1] Another sighting was reported on January 28, 2026, when an environmental lover, Vikas Gowda, saw a crocodile resting on the lake bund. [2] The Hindu reported a giant crocodile sighting on March 26, 2010, on the lake bund towards the university side. [3] News18 Kannada and Local18 also reported crocodile sightings in Kukkarahalli Lake on September 7, 2023. [4] [5] While the lake is known for its bird species and as a walking spot, crocodiles are present, and signboards warn people about their presence. [2] [6]
